title: Simulator TDMA transmit predicate expands into guard and adjacent slots
description: python/src/lichen/sim/tdma.py::TDMAScheduler.is_tx_allowed currently returns true from slot_start-guard through slot_end+guard. This authorizes transmission during both guard intervals and overlaps adjacent slots, defeating collision avoidance. The same module also retains obsolete 250 ms defaults and EUI64||epoch hashing, which are covered by 0ebk/55wi. Define the 2346 ms slot as maximum-frame airtime plus its 50 ms guard and restrict transmission to the data-airtime portion of the assigned slot, leaving a non-transmitting 50 ms guard; add exact start/end/neighbor-boundary tests.
